name: Path
description: Draw a path through every cell from 1 to n

rules.title: How to Play
rules.rule1: Start at 1 and visit every cell exactly once, ending at the last number
rules.rule2: Consecutive cells must touch up, down, left, or right — no diagonals
rules.rule3: Numbered cells are locked clues; visit them in order

nextSquare: Choose a square next to {number}, not diagonally.
deadEnd: No moves from here. Use Undo to back up.
wrongClue: That square is {clue} — step {expected} comes next.
nextBlank: Step {number}: choose a blank next to {previous}.
lockedClue: Step {number} can only go on its locked tile.
unreachableClue: Clue {number} isn’t adjacent. Undo the last step.
